I am looking for a PhD candidate with a background in HCI, Psychology, CS, AI, or related fields to empirically investigate how interactions with AI systems such as LLMs can become more resource-efficient, for example by helping users develop resource-aware prompting strategies or by providing real-time eco-feedback.

The position is full-time for four years and is part of the new Doctoral College on Computational Sustainability at Johannes Kepler University Linz and TU Vienna.

More details and application information can be found in the attached PDF or via this link:

Intended start date: September 2026

Application deadline: May 29, 2026

Sharing is very much appreciated.
